C1.rule: Mechanical, one owned file, fully specified, no design choice

C2.rule: Bounded implementation or tests, clear spec, one or two owned files and their tests

C3.rule: Cross-module design; changes a gate or the ledger contract; wrong means every project inherits it

C4.rule: Planning, merging, reconciling, anything in a project's real data, a sponsor decision

items.title: tracker import — an existing milestone plan becomes a ledger
items.what: Reads a project's plan -- CLAUDE-milestones.json when it exists (finance-tracker generates its table from it), else the ## Milestones table in CLAUDE-checklist.md through bin/milestones' own parse() -- and writes docs/proposals/NN-<slug>.json. Tracks become phases; state maps to the four ledger words with built as in progress (awaiting sign-off) and the source state kept verbatim in the log; every row is C4 until the lead decomposes it. Never overwrites, never reuses a proposal number, never writes a ledger that fails validation.
